title: AUTO-COMP: AN AUTOMATED PIPELINE FOR SCALABLE COMPOSITIONAL PROBING OF CONTRASTIVE VISION-LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating a text-only 'blind LLM' to guess the correct caption among hard negatives without visual input, verifying that the text is free of exploitable linguistic artifacts and structural giveaways.

Analyzing validation survival rates across different attributes (e.g., the spatial relation 'over' vs 'under', or common vs rare colors) to expose the underlying distributional preferences of the text-to-image generation models.

Testing vision-language models on a 'Confusion Benchmark' containing exhaustive combinations of repeated objects and attributes to measure the models' reliance on simplistic heuristics rather than true compositional reasoning.
